name: starflask_upload_media
description: Upload a local media file (image, video, or audio) to Starflask so it can be used as input to a generation job — e.g. the source still for image-to-video (kling-img2video), the reference image for image-to-3D, or the image to edit / upscale / remove background. Returns {id, url, content_hash}; pass the returned `url` as the image_url / video_url param of a subsequent job. The file must live under the agent's upload root (METALCRAFT_UPLOAD_ROOT, default <data>/uploads); files outside it are refused. Limits: images/svg 25MB, video/audio 100MB.

file_path.description: Path to the local media file to upload. Must resolve inside the configured upload root (METALCRAFT_UPLOAD_ROOT, default <data>/uploads).
